messages:
Maria (CS): quick flag — AcornLane onboarding: noticed 95th pct tail latency jumps on chat generate during peak (10:00-11:30 PT). renewal in ~60 days, pinging ops + eng for recs.
Ken (Solutions): ugh thanks, saw that in dashboards this morning. throughput steady but some requests spike tokens/time. do we have recent request samples?
Maria (CS): attaching short sample (copied): `user: 'summarize invoice and extract PO#'` — P95 ~ 1.7s -> 3.8s on some requests, cost up ~18%.
Devon (SE): thanks. quick sanity: what model & quant?
Maria (CS): they started on `redwood/gpt-large` hosted, default FP16. no explicit quant yet. using hosted routed -> eu-west.
OptimizeBot: automated suggestion: consider int8 quant candidate + regional routing fallback to us-west for burst capacity. estimated token-cost delta: -24% and latency P95 expected -30% on test traces.
Riley (Eng): can we try a hybrid approach: keep FP16 for safety on >2k-token requests, route <2k tokens to int8. also enable KV-prefix cache for their invoice prompts.
Ken (Solutions): that sounds good. Maria, want me to propose a canary plan to AcornLane? quick bullets to share with them: 1) 2-day int8 pilot on 10% traffic, 2) route EU bursts to US fallback, 3) measure quality on 300 prompt set.
Maria (CS): yes please. also note renewal lead is worried about cost creep. if we can show latency + cost wins w/ no regressions they'll be happier.
Devon (SE): implementation notes for the pilot (paste):
```
- create model variant: redwood/gpt-large:int8-preview
- route rule: if region==eu-west && p99_latency>2.5s -> fallback to us-west via policy 'fallback-usburst'
- traffic split: 90% FP16, 10% int8 preview (canary)
- eval set: /sprints/acornlane/quality-checks.csv (300 samples)
- logging: enable token-diff and soft-fail rollbacks
```
Ken (Solutions): will craft email with those bullets + expected metrics. want to include a rough rollback SLA window?
Maria (CS): yes, 24h automatic rollback on >1% quality regression or >10% error increase.
OptimizeBot: eval preview ran on 200 samples overnight: mean BLEU-ish proxy delta ~0.1% (within noise). flagged 3 outliers — recommend manual review. Link: https://redwood.internal/evals/preview/6329999999
Riley (Eng): re: routing — ensure the response streaming contract stays identical. we should verify client-side reconnect behavior for fallback.
Devon (SE): I'll add a small change to the SDK example to show model swap and routing override for canary: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/generate -d '{"model":"redwood/gpt-large:int8-preview","route":"fallback-usburst"}'`
Maria (CS): perfect. I'll schedule a 30m touchpoint with AcornLane CSM + Solutions tomorrow. Ken, can you draft the pilot plan by EOD?
Ken (Solutions): on it. ping me if you want the slide deck abbreviated.
Maria (CS): quick note for follow-up: capture customer feedback form after 48h of pilot and snapshot 50 random prompts for manual QA. I'll own that. :white_check_mark:
Riley (Eng): we'll add a tracing tag `acornlane-canary-6329999999` so ops can filter traces easily.
Devon (SE): one more thing — if we see hallucination regressions on invoice extraction, swap to FP16 for extract-only endpoints (reranker/extractor).
Maria (CS): noted. thanks all. I'll post pilot kickoff summary in #customer-success once Ken drafts the plan.
OptimizeBot: reminder scheduled: run auto-eval after 48h and post metrics to this thread. :robot_face:
